title: Reliability and Operational Resilience
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Reliability and Operational Resilience and define its core vocabulary.
Apply reliability and operational resilience in a small PowerShell example and predict its result.
Identify one relevant edge case, version constraint, or troubleshooting step.

content.intro: This lesson covers Reliability and Operational Resilience in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Measure a representative workload before optimizing. Reliable automation is modular, idempotent where practical, bounded in its retries and resources, and observable when failures occur. Avoid optimizing only for a synthetic benchmark that does not represent the real environment.
